profile.description: Evergent Investments SA is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm engages in management of financial instruments, shares, bonds, derivatives and other instruments devised by NSC regulations. The firm invests in the public equity and fixed income markets of Romania. It typically invests in companies in financial and energy sectors. Evergent Investments SA is based in Bacau, Romania along with additional office in Bucuresti, Romania.
